第18章 人命关天-《我发现了世界BUG》

视线中，银环蛇骤然出现，而它出现的同时，就已经到了那个男人身边。

林舒清晰地看到对方抬起了手，像是想要撒出什么东西，但下一秒，他的动作就僵在了原地。

他直挺挺地到了下去，脑袋撞在地面上，发出“砰”的一声巨响。

原本就安静的咖啡厅里静得像被谁按下了暂停键，所有人的目光都看向了门口。

“这他妈.......谁啊！？”

老板越过吧台，急匆匆地朝着男人的方向跑去。

“嘿！哥们！哥们！”

他蹲下身子，用力摇晃着男人的肩膀。

“卧槽......倒霉！”

“来个人帮我一下，这人晕了！”

店里的服务员手足无措地跑到老板身后，但也只是在那里站着，不知道应该做点什么。

“报警啊！等什么呢？！”

老板气急败坏地喊了一声，服务员这才反应过来。

寂静被打破，爱看热闹的人们纷纷起身凑了过来。

“什么情况？”

“不知道啊，我他么哪知道，他刚走进来就晕了！”

“碰瓷的？”

“不像，可能是低血糖？拿点糖浆过来喂他。”

“别喂别喂，这么喂搞不好会呛到，等医生来吧。”

“散开点、散开点，让他通风......”

......

众人手忙脚乱地想要去“抢救”那个晕厥的男人，林舒只是坐在吧台冷眼旁观。

没有任何人知道，这个男人的突然倒下跟自己有关。

当然也不会有任何人知道，这个男人本来是来要自己的命的。

但现在，命保住了，接下来呢？

直接给他带走，从他身上去搜消息？

应该没问题。

毕竟，那么多人都已经接触到他、碰到他了，但暂时还没有人出现不良反应。

那就证明，他的手段没有用上。

“让一下，让一下！”

林舒快步走上前去。

“我我有车，我送他到医院去！”

“这肯定是低血糖----低血糖不能耽误，等救护车过来就来不及了！”

林舒给出了一个冠冕堂皇的理由，而本来就不想惹事的老板立刻找到了台阶下。

“对对对，先送医院，先送医院！”

“来个人帮我把他抬到停车场，我车就在附近！”

“我来吧！”

In the sight, the bungara snake suddenly appeared, and at the same time it appeared, it was already at the man's side.

Lin Shu clearly saw the other person raise his hand, as if he wanted to throw something out, but the next second, his movements froze in place.

He fell straight down, and his head hit the ground with a loud "bang" sound.

The originally quiet cafe was as quiet as if someone had pressed the pause button, and everyone's eyes were turned to the door.

"Who the hell is this!?"

The boss crossed the bar and hurriedly ran in the direction of the man.

"Hey! Man! Man!"

He knelt down and shook the man's shoulders vigorously.

"Damn... bad luck!"

"Someone help me, this person is fainted!"

The waiter in the store ran behind the boss at a loss, but he just stood there, not knowing what to do.

"Call the police! What are you waiting for?!"

The boss yelled angrily, and then the waiter reacted.

The silence was broken, and people who loved to watch the excitement stood up and came over.

"What's going on?"

"I don't know. How could I know? He fainted as soon as he walked in!"

"Porcelain?"

"It doesn't look like it, maybe it's hypoglycemia? Bring some syrup and feed it to him."

"Don't feed it, don't feed it. You might choke if you feed it like this. Let's wait for the doctor to come."

"Spread out, spread out, let him ventilate..."

...

Everyone was hurriedly trying to "rescue" the fainted man, but Lin Shu just sat at the bar and watched coldly.

No one knew that this man's sudden collapse had something to do with them.

Of course, no one would know that this man originally came to take his own life.

But now, life is saved, what next?

Take him away directly and search for information from him?

It should be fine.

After all, so many people have been exposed to him and encountered him, but no one has had any adverse reactions yet.

That proves that his method was useless.

"Give me a moment, give me a moment!"

Lin Shu walked forward quickly.

"I, I have a car, I will take him to the hospital!"

"This must be hypoglycemia - hypoglycemia cannot be delayed. It will be too late to wait for the ambulance to come!"

Lin Shu gave a high-sounding reason, and the boss, who didn't want to cause trouble, immediately found his way down the steps.

"Yes, yes, send to the hospital first, send to the hospital first!"

"Someone help me carry him to the parking lot. My car is nearby!"

"I'll do it!"
